transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this schedule review meeting. As you know, we're revising the bell schedule for next academic year, and the current draft has classes starting at 8:00 a.m., dismissing at 2:45 p.m., with a 25-minute lunch period. The draft preserves seven instructional periods and is intended to keep total instructional time unchanged. Before I make a final decision on the schedule and its implementation procedures, I'd like to hear from our transportation coordinator and staff-labor liaison regarding any operational requirements or concerns. Please go ahead and share your reports.

transcript.text: Dr. Bennett, I need to flag a critical transportation constraint. The contracted bus routes for next year can only serve this school with an 8:20 a.m. arrival and a 3:05 p.m. dismissal. I received the revised route confirmation from the transportation contractor this morning. I should note that the scheduling spreadsheet still shows last year's times, so it hasn't been updated to reflect this. The current draft schedule of 8:00 a.m. to 2:45 p.m. is not compatible with our contracted bus routes.
